text.p: The Snapshot tool is used to read snapshot traces from the target device. This support multiple types of target connections.
Use the "Snapshot Engine" dropdown menu to select the right connection type. For each type, different Settings will be available.
When ready with the setup, click on the "Read Snapshot" button to read the trace data from your target device.
For SEGGER J-Link connections, the snapshot tool also provides buttons for Halt, Resume, and Reset, that lets your control the your target device.
